subject: DPA / SCCs: redlines, controller roles, and transfer-impact addendum
messages:
From: Emma King <emma.king@techhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@techhealth.com, Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@techhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Oct 2025 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Initial DPA redlines and SCCs questions

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — procurement and legal at TechHealth are ready to move, but we have a few outstanding items on the DPA and SCCs that we need clarified before routing to our execs. Attached are our annotated redlines (TechHealth_Redlines_2025-10-21.pdf). High-level asks: 

- We need a short addendum that documents our requirement for EU-only processing for a subset of PHI-derived features (onshore routing). Can Redwood provide an explicit onshore routing commitment for that tenant?
- Please confirm controller vs processor responsibilities in Section 3 — our counsel is asking for language around joint-controller scenarios for model outputs used to train third-party analytics.
- SCCs: we requested the modular SCC approach you mentioned; legal wants to see an exhibit that maps which clauses apply when Private (VPC) or Dedicated is used.
- Can you share an evidence bundle for subprocessor onboarding and a SOC-2 excerpt that shows KMS integration?

We are aiming to sign the order form by the end of next week but need clarity on the above. Can you confirm owners and a short timeline for answering each item?

Regards,
Emma King
Legal Counsel, TechHealth Labs
emma.king@techhealth.com

Attachment: TechHealth_Redlines_2025-10-21.pdf (annotated redline PDF, ~8 pages)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma King <emma.king@techhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@techhealth.com>, procurement@techhealth.com
Date: Tue, 21 Oct 2025 18:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Initial DPA redlines and SCCs questions

Emma — thanks for the notes and the redlines. I reviewed the PDF and pulled out the four asks you listed. Short answers here and a proposed plan below: 

- Onshore routing for the PHI subset: possible via Dedicated pools or Private (VPC) with region pinning. Ops needs to confirm queue-level routing SLA; I can get that by Wed EOD.
- Controller/processor language: legal (cc'd) will propose one of two standard templates (joint-controller limited to downstream analytics). I will loop them in below.
- SCCs modular exhibit: we have a modular exhibit draft — attaching RWD_DPA_Modular_SCCs_v3.docx for review. It maps deployment modes to clause sets.
- Evidence bundle: sending the SOC-2 excerpt + KMS integration notes in a separate secure share; alternatively, we can run a quick call for your security team.

Proposed short timeline:
1) Wed (10/22): Ops confirms routing SLA and onshore feasibility (Ben to own).
2) Thu (10/23): Legal provides draft joint-controller wording for review (Laura to own).
3) Fri (10/24): We send consolidated redline response & updated DPA exhibit.
4) Early next week: sign-off / DocuSign routing.

If that works I’ll open a Jira ticket and attach the updated DPA; please let me know any internal deadlines on your side.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0122

Attachment: RWD_DPA_Modular_SCCs_v3.docx (draft exhibit mapping clauses to deployment modes)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: None
Date: Wed, 22 Oct 2025 09:17:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Initial DPA redlines and SCCs questions — action items (Ben/Laura/Neha)

Folks — forwarding TechHealth's redlines. Please see the inline asks above. Quick breakdown and owners: 

Ben: can you confirm whether we can guarantee per-tenant EU-only routing for a labeled data stream (PHI-derived features) if TechHealth commits to Dedicated capacity or Private VPC? If there are operational caveats (fallback to closest region during outages, mission-critical exceptions), list them. Need ETA Wed EOD so I can push to customer.

Laura: Legal to propose joint-controller wording. TechHealth is specifically worried about model output reuse for third-party analytics — they want clarity we won't re-use tenant outputs for training third parties without consent. Can you draft a tight paragraph and indicate if we accept joint-controller for specific outputs only? ETA Thu lunchtime please.

Neha: Security evidence pack — can you pull the SOC-2 excerpt showing KMS integration and a short note on subprocessor onboarding (timelines + attestations)? If you prefer, we can set a 30-min call with Emma's security lead (Jordan Mills).

I opened INF-3245 to track the routing addendum and linked the HubSpot company record and the DocuSign routing template. I’ll consolidate the responses into RWD_DPA_Modular_SCCs_v3 and return to TechHealth Friday.

Thanks —
Marissa

Related links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3245 | https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/98765
From: Jordan Mills <jordan.mills@techhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma King <emma.king@techhealth.com>, procurement@techhealth.com
Date: Mon, 27 Oct 2025 22:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: DPA / SCCs: redlines, controller roles, and transfer-impact addendum

Marissa,

Appreciate the quick turnaround — the team reviewed the consolidated exhibit and the drafted paragraph from your legal counsel (Laura). Good news: procurement is comfortable with the proposed onshore routing commitment when TechHealth signs up for a Dedicated pool and we see the routing SLA caveats documented. Legal did request two minor edits, both tracked in the attached PDF.

We’ve attached the signed order form and our final counters (TechHealth_Signed_Orderform_2025-10-27.pdf). We will route DocuSign for signature tomorrow AM unless you push any further changes. 

One last ask before DocuSign: please include the modular SCC exhibit as Schedule 3 and the routing addendum as Schedule 4 in the DocuSign packet. Can you confirm that and send the packet link?

Thanks — looking forward to closing.

Jordan Mills
Sr. Procurement Manager, TechHealth Labs
jordan.mills@techhealth.com

Attachments: TechHealth_Signed_Orderform_2025-10-27.pdf (signed copy), TechHealth_Final_Counters_2025-10-27.pdf (2 pages)
